recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up is needed for FHIR-17176 unless a future Imaging Integration decision changes the R6-era ImagingStudy.description or DICOM mapping policy.
issue_request: FHIR-17176 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification Imaging Integration request to add ImagingStudy.description as a 0..1 summary string for the image-manager-supplied study description, with DICOM Study Description (0008,1030) mapping, instead of using ImagingStudy.note for that meaning.
initial_application: The issue was applied by SVN 14695, represented in git as c5f22292a1056857e00a3a4c93ca2c4ffd1fa905, which added the ImagingStudy.description row to the old spreadsheet source and moved DICOM Study Description away from ImagingStudy.note. The 2021 source refactor carried the element into the current StructureDefinition source.
additional_context: FHIR-12269 is the cited DICOM mapping tracker and says study-level description, if present, maps to (0008,1030), while note maps to (0040,0280). Later applied R6 issues FHIR-47672 and FHIR-47520 clarified ImagingStudy.description wording and DICOM tag mapping labels without reversing the original element addition. ImagingStudy is active and approved in source/fhir.ini, so source/imagingstudy/structuredefinition-ImagingStudy.xml is current build scope.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Current source defines ImagingStudy.description as 0..1 string, summary=true, mapped to DICOM Study Description (0008,1030), and the current ImagingStudy.note source no longer carries the study-description DICOM mapping.
